part.text:
Fix complete. The issue was in `lib/core/AxiosHeaders.js`:

- **`normalize()`** stringified every value, so array-valued headers like `set-cookie` were flattened to a comma-joined string when response transforms ran (lib/core/transformData.js:25). Now arrays are preserved, with each item normalized like `set()` does.
- **`toJSON()`** unconditionally joined arrays with `', '`. It now preserves arrays by default and only joins when `asStrings` is passed — matching how request senders consume it (per-item iteration in xhr/node adapters).

Verified: the FAIL_TO_PASS cases (`test/unit/regression/bugs.js` issue 5028, `normalize()` array-values spec) now pass, along with all 100 other unit tests. The only 2 failures (`should support max content length`, `should support HTTPS protocol`) hit external network hosts and fail/flake identically on the unmodified baseline.
